Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE_1 is the edit target, an existing painted child mermaid costume prototype on transparent RGBA. Fill ONLY the small transparent gap between the bottom of Roshan's chin/neck and the painter bodice neckline and shoulder straps, approximately x460–615,y329–400 in the 1024-square input. Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Asset type: one RGBA painted sprite contact-part source. IMAGE_1 is Roshan's approved neutral anatomy/style reference. IMAGE_2 is the actual painter brush design. Draw ONLY one close-up of Roshan's SCREEN-LEFT hand with a short wrist/forearm end, no other character or face, holding this coral brush securely. The wrist enters from upper RIGHT and the fingers/palm point down LEFT as in IMAGE_1's screen-left hand at the end of her relaxed arm. Preserve the same childlike warm skin, slender wrist, soft hand shape and polished 2D paint/outline style. Five fingers total including thumb: fingers naturally CURLED around the handle, thumb pressing the near side; clear believable contact, not an open hand behind a floating brush. Brush handle gold/cream shell ferrule and coral handle; bristles tipped coral, no dripping ribbon. Position brush bristles up/left relative to the hand, handle passing diagonally across the palm, fingers in FRONT where wrapped, handle visible behind the fingers. A matching useful grip in frontal-view perspective, no extreme foreshortening, no 3D. This is an authored alternate grasp view, not a new hand design or an animation frame series. Large enough to cleanly isolate the hand and tool together. True transparent RGBA, generous padding, no text, labels, shadows, background, duplicate hands, extra digits or detached fingers.
